fr.short: Échange structuré informations entre composants système ou membres équipe via canaux synchrones ou asynchrones
fr.full:
La **communication** est l'échange structuré d'informations entre composants système ou membres d'équipe, via canaux synchrones ou asynchrones.

**Technique** : synchrone (HTTP, RPC) vs asynchrone (queues, events). Patterns : request-reply, pub-sub, streaming.

**Équipe** : synchrone (réunions, chat) vs asynchrone (email, documentation). Outils : Slack, RabbitMQ, Kafka.

**Best practices** : timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotence, clear channels, documentation async-first.

en.short: Structured exchange of information between system components or team members through synchronous or asynchronous channels
en.full:
**Communication** is the structured exchange of information between system components or team members, through synchronous or asynchronous channels.

**Technical** : synchronous (HTTP, RPC) vs asynchronous (queues, events). Patterns: request-reply, pub-sub, streaming.

**Team** : synchronous (meetings, chat) vs asynchronous (email, documentation). Tools: Slack, RabbitMQ, Kafka.

**Best practices** : timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, clear channels, async-first documentation.
